prompt: Create one transparent-background pixel-art idle boss sprite for a MapleStory-like side scrolling RPG lab: Genshin Impact Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Mikoto, Baleful Shadowlord armored puppet form. Reference image 1 is the full model silhouette and construction, reference 2 is face/armor colors. Preserve recognizability rather than generic purple warrior. Whole figure with generous transparent margins, three-quarter frontal facing slightly right. Central small adult woman with long dark indigo hair, gold horned headpiece, ivory/lavender armored bodice, asymmetrical dark shoulder armor, purple and burgundy draped tails. She stands on TWO large golden mechanical hands, palms facing upward and fingers forward. Behind her ONE enormous lavender mechanical arm on viewer-left holds the long gently curved purple sword across lower foreground pointing right; THREE slender segmented lavender arms on viewer-right fan upward/middle/lower, middle hand holding purple diamond-like spear ornament. Violet circular halo of electro medallions behind upper body. Keep distinct negative spaces between arms and central body; no extra arms. All swords, halo and hand-platform fully in frame. Static neutral idle display, no attack action/projectiles, no ground, no background, no lettering/watermarks/UI. Crisp chunky pixel clusters, dark outlines, restrained 24-32 color look, clean hard alpha, no blur/soft glow. Designed to remain readable at 200px whole height; simplify engraving while retain gold, ivory, violet and indigo color regions. Not a sprite sheet; exactly one full isolated boss.
